qrList.label: Get All Message Names
qrList.message:
/message-list 0--1 |
/setvar key=testList |

/setglobalvar key=NameDict {} |

/foreach {{getvar::testList}} {:
	/getat index={{var::index}} {{getvar::testList}} |
	/= pipe.name |
	/let key=MessageName |
	
	/setat value={{getglobalvar::NameDict}} index={{var::MessageName}} 0 |
	/setglobalvar key=NameDict |
	
:} |

/flushvar testList |

qrList.label: Message Tagging
qrList.message:
/message-get -1 |
/= pipe.name |
/setvar key=MessageName |
/setvar key=MessageRaw {{lastMessage}} |

/if left={{getvar::MessageRaw}} right=<think> rule=nin {:
	/if left={{getvar::MessageName}} right={{user}} rule=eq else={:
		/if left={{lastSwipeId}} right=1 rule=eq {:
			/getat index={{getvar::MessageName}} {{getglobalvar::NameDict}} |
			/= {{pipe}} + 1 |
			/setat value={{getglobalvar::NameDict}} index={{getvar::MessageName}} |
			/setglobalvar key=NameDict |
		:} |
	:} 
	
	{:
		/getat index={{getvar::MessageName}} {{getglobalvar::NameDict}} |
		/= {{pipe}} + 1 |
		/setat value={{getglobalvar::NameDict}} index={{getvar::MessageName}} |
		/setglobalvar key=NameDict |
	:} |

	/getat index={{getvar::MessageName}} {{getglobalvar::NameDict}} |
	/setvar key=editID |
	
	/setvar key=editValue "{{getvar::MessageName}} Message #{{getvar::editID}}: " |
	
	/regex name="Message Tags" {{getvar::MessageRaw}} |
	/setvar key=MessageRegex |
	/message-edit message={{lastMessageId}} |
	
	/if left={{lastMessage}} right={{getvar::editValue}} rule=nin {: 
		/message-edit message={{lastMessageId}} {{getvar::editValue}} |
		/message-edit message={{lastMessageId}} append=true {{getvar::MessageRegex}} |
	:} |
	
	/flushvar MessageRegex |
	/flushvar editID |
	/flushvar editValue |
:} |

/flushvar MessageName |
/flushvar MessageRaw |

qrList.label: Multi Message Tagging
qrList.message:
/message-list 0--1 |
/setvar key=allMessages ||

/message-list {{firstDisplayedMessageId}}--1 |
/setvar key=messagesList |

/foreach {{getvar::allMessages}} {:
	/getat index={{var::index}} {{getvar::allMessages}} |
	/= pipe.name |
	/setvar key=MessageName |
	
	/getat index={{getvar::MessageName}} {{getglobalvar::NameDict}} |
	/= {{pipe}} + 1 |
	/setat value={{getglobalvar::NameDict}} index={{getvar::MessageName}} |
	/setglobalvar key=NameDict ||
	
	/if left={{var::index}} right={{firstDisplayedMessageId}} rule=gte {:
		/messages names=off hidden=on {{var::index}} |
		/setvar key=MessageRaw |
		
		/getat index={{getvar::MessageName}} {{getglobalvar::NameDict}} |
		/setvar key=editID |
	
		/setvar key=editValue "{{getvar::MessageName}} Message #{{getvar::editID}}: " |
		
		/regex name="Message Tags" {{getvar::MessageRaw}} |
		/setvar key=MessageRegex |
		/message-edit message={{var::index}} |
		
		/if left={{getvar::MessageRaw}} right=<think> rule=nin {:		 
			/message-edit message={{var::index}} {{getvar::editValue}} |
			/message-edit message={{var::index}} append=true {{getvar::MessageRegex}} :} |
		:} |
	:} |
	
	/flushvar MessageName |
	/flushvar MessageRaw |
	/flushvar MessageRegex |
	/flushvar editID |
	/flushvar editValue |
:} ||

/flushvar messagesList |
/flushvar allMessages |
